86c6b6.conditions: 1x3x1 grid: only RD_L/RD_U reduction messages reach the wildcard receives (pdgstrs3d.c:3903, 5946); arrival order only changes floating-point summation order
86c6b6.reasoning: With the default NEW3DSOLVETREECOMM path, the only wildcard receives on the run path are the MPI_Recv(ANY_SOURCE, ANY_TAG) loops in dForwardSolve3d_newsolve_reusepdgstrs and dBackSolve3d_newsolve_reusepdgstrs. With nprow=1 the broadcast trees are empty (nfrecvx=nbrecvx=0), so only RD_L or RD_U lsum messages arrive. Each carries its block number in the header, the tag is dispatched, and the per-block fmod/bmod counters make processing independent of order. The loop counts match the tree destCnt. A barrier separates the L and U phases. Before and after each solve are only collectives (Alltoallv, Allreduce, Barrier), and pdgsmv uses specific sources (it has no traffic for this block-diagonal split), so no message from another phase can be taken. Factorization receives name their source. The only effect of matching order is the floating-point summation order of lsum, i.e. last-bit differences, not a hang, crash or wrong result.
